rationale: The last three candles show a clear momentum shift — price broke back above the 9-EMA ($16.40) on the highest volume candle since entry (230,970 shares), indicating a buying surge that is directly challenging the gap-fade thesis. The stock has moved from 13% of today's range at entry to 22% now, recovering off the $16.25 low with increasing participation rather than continued selling. While invalidation at $16.68 has not been breached, the adverse excursion (-0.55%) already exceeds the maximum favorable excursion (0.28%), and the mechanical edge for the short has weakened materially enough to warrant exiting at a modest loss rather than risking a run toward the hard stop.
